integrity: Proof and complete assumptions included; public numerical checker reproduces 392 matrix and optimality consistency tests. Historical priority is qualified by searchable-index limits and incomplete access to two related public research records. No claim of external certification.
scientific_limitations: Finite connected noncomplete unweighted strongly regular graphs, and positive coupling only. All-graph claim proved analytically for this class; tests on seven examples are consistency checks. No general weighted or multi-eigenvalue graph extension and no independent mathematical validation.
title: A unique worst positivity delay for mixed heat on every strongly regular graph
